chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: Everything into the Sludge Spinner's face. Gorou is free, so it goes first for 6 at no energy cost. All Streams Flow to the Sea for 1 energy reads Charge 8 at one point per two Charge, so 9 + 4 = 13. Itto - Oni Rush for the remaining 2 energy, taking the Deal 14 damage half. Total 33 into a 38 HP enemy, leaving it at 5. I eat the telegraphed 8, going to 40/70, and it dies next turn to literally any single card in the deck, including another free Gorou-tier hit or one Water's Edge. That was the maximum damage available on 3 energy: the only other 1-cost attacks are Water's Edge at 6, so swapping either 1-cost attack for one loses damage, and Itto's 14 for 2 energy beats two Water's Edge at 12.
q2_other_line_considered: Two, briefly. First, Bake-Kurage — summon a body for a turn, +1 Charge, Burst +5. I rejected it on arithmetic: Charge 8 to 9 buys nothing, because All Streams reads one point per two Charge and 9 rounds to the same 4 bonus, so the 1 energy spent on Kurage costs me a real card this turn and returns a one-turn summon plus a Burst I am not holding. Second, the full defensive turn: Itto on the Gain 6 Block half plus one Coral Guard is 11 Block against an 8, fully blanking the hit, with free Gorou still poking for 6. That is strictly better on HP but it does not race — the Spinner sits at 32 and I have spent a turn of a 38 HP fight buying back 8 HP I can afford to lose at 48/70. Racing wins the fight a turn or two sooner and takes one hit total.
q3_what_it_gave_up: 8 HP, taken on the chin, and the two Coral Guards plus both Block modes went unused this turn. It also gave up the Bake-Kurage summon and its Burst +5 — if there is a Burst payoff later in this fight, this line never set it up, and it spent the Charge-scaled All Streams now at 13 rather than banking Charge for a bigger one later. And it exhausted Gorou, so that free 6 is gone from the deck for the rest of the run of this fight.
q4_different_intent: Yes. The 8 is small enough that trading HP for tempo is clearly correct at 48/70. If the Spinner had telegraphed something in the high teens or worse — anything that made the incoming hit a meaningful fraction of my 48 — I would flip Itto to Gain 6 Block and add both Coral Guards for 16 Block, with free Gorou still hitting for 6, and accept the slow race. Likewise if it had telegraphed a debuff or a defensive/Block intent that would blunt this turn's damage, the 33 would partly evaporate and I would take the Bake-Kurage line instead, banking Charge and the summon for a turn when the damage actually lands.
